title: Published tombstone
description: Contract for a retired entity id that was merged into a surviving id. Served at v1/{dataset}/{retired-id}.json so a stored bookmark forwards instead of 404ing, which makes docs/model.md's 'ids are never deleted' promise true for merged datasets (today only camps: duplicate and program-variant listings folded into their base camp). `gone` is always true and is what distinguishes a tombstone from a live entity document; `moved_to` is the surviving id, a bare dataset-scoped slug identical to the aliases-map value it mirrors. GitHub Pages cannot issue a 301, so this machine-readable stub is the forward. The retirement version is not recorded here because merges carry no date in the source data; the diffable retirement signal is the set of tombstones (equivalently the aliases map) between two builds.
